notes.text: M0: Supply is TIGHT (100% confirmed: ap 12m reserve capped at 1 of 2 kH

M1: Supply ~88% TIGHT (idx +6.5% to 1.704, spot/idx 1.97, despite loose news). Launch month prior 11..18 (no news yet). Brokers untested 50/50. Inference growth 50/50 (M0 was 5.74 kH). Plan: lowered ap spot to 0.4 kH to cap expensive spot while covering ap demand above 1 kH reserve, moved 0.28k idle H from us to eu spare power, monitoring growth before next capex/power.

M2: Supply ~50/50 TIGHT vs LOOSE (M1 shipped 2.5k confirming M1 tight and idx jumped +18.5% to 2.020, but M2 news is loose and spot/idx dropped to 1.34 suggesting possible switch to loose). Launch month prior 11..18. Broker A 1k test order placed (50/50 prior). Inference growth ~80% 7% (M0 5.74 -> M1 6.62, +15.3%). Plan: signed 10MW ap (M8), ordered 6kH vendor ap + 1kH broker A ap to prepare for 8..15 training (246 kH-m needed at 7%), set ap spot 0.5.

M3: Supply ~99% TIGHT (M2 shipped 2.38k, idx +9.6% to 2.214, spot/idx 1.885, news tight). Launch month rumour around 16 -> true launch 14..18 (mean 16, so gen N arrives too late for 8..15). Broker A 1k awaiting confirmation end of M3 (50/50 prior). Inference growth ~55% 7% / ~45% 3% (M0 5.74, M1 6.62, M2 6.47). Plan: move 2.58k unpowered H from us to ap for M4 8MW energisation, keep 0.5 ap spot for M3 only (turn off in M4).

M4: Supply ~97% TIGHT (M3 shipped 1.56k, idx +5.1% to 2.328, spot/idx 2.37 with rival buying x1.5). Launch month rumour around 18 -> intersected with 14..18 and prior 11..18 gives 16..18 (mean 17, gen N arrives M19..21). Broker A cancelled #5 -> ~87% unreliable (avoid). Inference growth ~98% 3% (M0..M3: 5.74, 6.62, 6.47, 6.21). Plan: turn off ap spot immediately now that ap 8MW + 5.58kH are online, hold cash and watch 9.11k queue + export control risk before next capex.

M5: Supply ~88% TIGHT (M4 shipped 1.67k, idx -0.1% to 2.325, news tight, though spot/idx dropped to 1.01). Launch month 16..18 (mean 17, gen N arrives M19..21). Broker A ~87% unreliable, B untested. Inference growth ~99.9% 3% (M4 6.64 kH). Plan: signed 8MW ap (M9) and ordered 6kH vendor ap to cover 16..23 gap cheaply (~1.4-1.6M/kH-mo vs 1.77M options) and insure against 3%->7% switch in 8..15.

M6: Supply ~55-65% LOOSE / 35-45% TIGHT (M5 shipped 1.73k and idx +8.8% to 2.529 confirming M5 tight, but M6 spot/idx dropped to 0.853 with loose news suggesting possible switch to loose). Launch month 16..18 (mean 17). Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth ~99.9% 3% (M5 6.66 kH). Export control rumour again. Plan: hold steady as 0..7 run is already done (62.21/60), us 6MW turns on M7 and ap 10MW turns on M8.

M7: Supply ~98% LOOSE (M6 shipped 4.78k, idx -0.8% to 2.508, spot/idx 0.955, loose news). Launch month rumour 17 -> intersected with prior rumours gives 16..18 (mean 17). Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth ~99.9% 3% (M6 7.19 kH), entering 8..15 window where 50% switch to 7% is possible. Plan: stop buying gen H since 33k H covers 8..15 with surplus even under a 3%->7% switch, wait for M10-12 to renew eu/us power and M16-18 for gen N + options/post-launch cloud for 16..23.

M8: Supply ~78% LOOSE / 22% TIGHT (M7 shipped 4.81k and idx -7.5% to 2.321 confirming M7 loose, M8 spot/idx 1.44 neutral, no news). Launch month 16..18 (rumours 16,18,17,18 -> leaning 17-18). Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth 3% so far (M7 6.48 kH), watching for possible 3%->7% switch in 8..15. Plan: hold cash as ap 8MW turns on M9 and queue #6 finishes, renew eu 6MW at M10 and us 10MW at M11.

M9: Supply ~78% TIGHT / 22% LOOSE (M8 idx -3.5% to 2.240 confirming M8 loose, but M9 spot/idx spiked to 2.54 suggesting probable switch back to tight). Launch month 16..18. Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth 3% so far (M8 7.71 kH, +1.4% vs 3% trend). Plan: hold cash, renew eu 6MW at M10 and us 10MW at M11, rely on options (1.77M/kH-mo) + post-launch cloud + early gen N if M16 for 16..23.

M10: Supply ~98% TIGHT (idx +5.3% to 2.359, spot/idx 2.18, tight news). Launch month 16..18. Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth 3% so far (M9 7.91 kH, +1.0% vs 3% trend). Plan: signed 6MW eu replacement power (energises M18), will sign 10MW us replacement power in M11.

M11: Supply ~68% TIGHT / 32% LOOSE (idx +2.0% to 2.406 confirming M10 tight, M11 spot/idx 1.54 with loose news). Launch month 16..18 (rumour 17). Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth ~80% still 3% / ~20% switched to 7% (M10 jumped to 8.68 kH, +7.7% above 3% trend, watching M11). Plan: signed 10MW us replacement power (energises M14), letting 1kH ap/us reserves expire after M12, saving cash for options and post-launch cloud/gen N for 16..23.

M12: Supply ~98% TIGHT (idx +10.6% to 2.662, spot/idx 1.66, tight news). Launch month PINNED to 16 or 17 (50/50: rumours 16,18,17,18,15 intersect to 16..17). Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth 3% so far (M11 8.10 kH, -2.5% vs 3% trend). Plan: hold cash for M15-17 options (1.77M/kH-mo beats gen H/N with new power and current cloud), will check post-launch cloud/gen N on spare power at M16-17.

M13: Supply ~68% TIGHT / 32% LOOSE (idx +3.1% to 2.744 confirming M12 tight, M13 spot/idx dropped to 1.23, no news). Launch month PINNED to 16 (100% certain: M13 rumour 14 intersects 16..17 at 16). Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth 3% so far (M12 8.73 kH, +2.1% vs 3% trend). Plan: wait for M15 to buy and exercise 20kH options (16..21), and M16 to order 1.1k gen N on existing spare power + M17 options as needed.

M14: Supply ~82% LOOSE / 18% TIGHT (idx +0.8% to 2.767, spot/idx dropped to 0.803 following M13 1.23, indicating likely switch to loose). Launch month PINNED to 16 (M14 rumour 14 confirms 16). Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth still 3% (M13 8.78 kH, -0.3% vs 3% trend). Plan: wait for M15 to buy and exercise 20kH options for 16..21, then in M16-17 add 1.12k gen N on existing spare power plus final tranche of options for 18..23.

M15: Supply ~75% TIGHT / 25% LOOSE (idx +0.2% to 2.772, spot/idx jumped to 2.015). Launch month 16 (100% pinned by M13=14 and M4/M8=18, though vendor did not pre-confirm in 20% case). Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth ~60% stayed 3% / ~40% switched to 7% around M13-14 (M14 jumped to 9.87 kH, +8.8% over 3% trend). Export control rumour. Plan: bought and exercised 20kH options (14 us, 4 eu, 2 ap) for M16..21, will inspect M16 gen N launch and inference demand to size final M16-17 gen N and options for M18..23.

M16: Supply ~75% TIGHT / 25% LOOSE (pre-drop idx +5.8% confirming M15 tight, M16 tight news, though spot/idx 1.08). Launch month CONFIRMED 16 (gen N launched now!). Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth ~99% 3% (M15 9.35 kH, exact 3% trend, M8..15 switch window ended). Plan: ordered 0.86k N ap + 0.25k N us to fill existing spare power (1.45M/kH-mo in M19..23), will buy and exercise 4kH options in M17 for M18..23 to secure 320 training with buffer.

M17: Supply ~98% TIGHT (idx +2.8% to 2.261, spot/idx 2.73 with rival buying, tight news). Launch month WAS 16 (gen N active). Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth ~99.9% 3% (M16 9.83 kH, +2.1% vs 3% trend). Plan: bought and exercised 3kH options in us for M18..23 (gives ~327/320 expected 16..23 training with >5-sigma buffer while saving 0.6M vs 4kH, can fine-tune in M21-22 if needed).

M18: Supply ~95% TIGHT (idx +3.8% to 2.347, tight news, spot/idx 1.30). Launch month was 16. Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth 3% (M17 9.87 kH, -0.5% vs 3% trend). Plan: hold steady as 3kH us options begin M18..23 and 1.11k gen N should arrive for M19, monitoring 16..23 progress (86.31/320).

M19: Supply ~99% TIGHT (idx +6.1% to 2.490, tight news, rival buying spot at 16.38M). Launch month was 16. Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth 3% (M18 10.68 kH, +4.5% vs 3% trend). Plan: all 1.11k gen N delivered and powered, holding steady on track for ~327/320 in 16..23 and verifying buffer in M21-22.

M20: Supply ~95% TIGHT (idx +7.8% to 2.683, spot/idx 1.67). Launch month was 16. Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth ~98.5% 3% / ~1.5% switch at M15 (M19 jumped to 11.63 kH, +10.5% over 3% trend, checking M20 demand next month). Export control rumour. Plan: hold steady with 178.21/320 done and +5.75 buffer expected, check M20 demand at M21 to decide if any top-up option/spot is needed for M22-23.

M21: Supply ~98% TIGHT (idx +0.7% to 2.702, spot/idx 1.85, tight news). Launch month was 16. Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth SWITCHED 3%->7% around M13-15 (M20 jumped to 14.65 kH!). Plan: bought and exercised 9kH options (2 eu, 7 us for M22..27) to cover the ~14 kH-mo 320 training shortfall and protect eu inference after 4kH eu option expires after M21.

M22: Supply ~50/50 TIGHT vs LOOSE (idx -2.3% to 2.640 and loose news vs spot/idx 1.79). Launch month was 16. Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth 7% post-switch (M21 14.27 kH). Plan: hold steady with 265.75/320 done and 94.44 kH-mos capacity across M22-23 (~+7 buffer above 320), verify exact final month need at M23.

M23: Supply ~95% TIGHT (idx +9.9% to 2.902, spot/idx 2.29, tight news). Launch month was 16. Broker A ~87% unreliable. Inference growth 7% post-switch (M22 14.77 kH). Plan: final month M23 needs only 21.79 training with 47.22 kH capacity (~15.8 kH inf expected), resell 3k idle-margin H at ap before final depreciation while keeping +6.6 kH safety buffer, end game cleanly.
